icon-sets-tabler from the command line

What this page does, as commands. Add --json --non-interactive in a script or CI.

Check upstream 
icon-sets-sync check --pack icon-sets-tabler
Dry run 
icon-sets-sync sync --pack icon-sets-tabler --dry-run
Real sync (commits, pushes, opens a pull request) 
icon-sets-sync sync --pack icon-sets-tabler --non-interactive
Recipe at a version 
icon-sets-sync recipe icon-sets-tabler --version 3.40.0 --dry-run

GitHub Actions

In the pack repository's .github/workflows/sync-upstream.yml. Pin toolkit-ref and the uses line to the same commit SHA.

Workflow job 
jobs:
  sync:
    uses: ichava/icon-sets-sync/.github/workflows/sync-pack.yml@<sha>
    with:
      pack: icon-sets-tabler
      toolkit-ref: <sha>
      refresh-app-client-id: ${{ vars.REFRESH_APP_CLIENT_ID }}
    secrets:
      refresh-app-private-key: ${{ secrets.REFRESH_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
